name: pirate-cove
description: A salt-stained pirate cove: a lively crew, strange sea creatures, treasure, rigging and nautical props in torn paper.
stylePrompt: Torn and cut paper collage in a muted mid-century palette of navy, moss green, brick red, mustard, cream and dusty pink. Every shape is visibly hand-cut or torn, with deckled edges, paper grain and dry speckled texture; tiny details are fine black ink. Flat, straight-on puppet-theatre silhouettes with no perspective, lighting, gradients, shadows, white outlines or 3D rendering. Full isolated pirate characters, sea creatures and nautical props on transparent backgrounds.
